security: Encoding corruption that the prior review flagged as security-relevant (re-encoded string literals inside semgrep/trivy/quality-gate parsers) is verified absent at HEAD: no UTF-8 BOM and no mojibake sequences (鈥/鈫/锟) remain in any source/JSON file, and the quality_gate summary em dash at packages/plugin-quality-gate/src/index.ts:365 is intact. Residual risk: nothing prevents recurrence — see test_gaps.

The 'security' preset registers quality_gate without registering Ruff/Biome. This is NOT a runtime failure today because quality_gate composes lane tools via direct static imports (packages/plugin-quality-gate/src/index.ts:37-40, 141-148) rather than host registry resolution, so the lint lane still runs. However, a host that exposes only preset-registered tools will not surface ruff_check/biome_check, and quality_gate's advertised lint:python/lint:web capabilities are not independently reachable from the security preset; a future refactor to host-resolved lanes would silently degrade the lint lane. Recommend a test pinning lane skip-vs-fail behavior under the security preset.

No new permission surface introduced: bundling act/docker/k6 into 'devops' and semgrep/trivy/quality-gate into 'security' does not alter per-tool mutationClass or DSH permission gating; presets are composition-only arrays of existing plugin objects.
test_gaps: No release-consistency test asserting every package.json version AND every plugin metadata.version equals CORE_VERSION — this is exactly what let metadata.version stay at 0.1.0 across all 11 plugins while smoke.test.ts only checks CORE_VERSION; the drift was caught by manual review, not CI.
No CI/encoding guard (lint rule or script) rejecting UTF-8 BOMs and mojibake in source/JSON files; the 29-file re-encoding corruption in ab49905 passed test/typecheck/lint/build undetected.
No test asserting every plugin referenced by a preset is declared as a dependency of presets/presets/package.json; a missing workspace dep would fail only at preset load/import time.

No test pinning quality_gate lane behavior when Ruff/Biome are not registered (currently skipped-fine by direct import); guards against a regression toward host-resolved lanes that would break the security preset.

architecture: Preset composition gap: the 'security' preset's quality_gate tool depends on Ruff/Biome lane tools that are only registered via the coding/python/web presets; it works at runtime only because of direct module imports rather than the host tool registry. Preset→plugin dependency coverage is not validated.

The version bump is applied as manual per-file edits with no shared version source (e.g., a single constant imported by all metadata objects); this is the second occurrence of version-skew drift across plugins (see prior PR-41/PR-50 review notes on hardcoded coreContractVersion), so recurrence is likely without a shared constant or the consistency test proposed above.
